angles.hook: The lamp is still on. Three lines, then I stop.
angles.audience: People who mean to write a letter and keep putting it off until night
angles.whyItSpreads: Someone else delaying a letter will pass it to a friend, because the lamp on the desk matches their night.

angles.hook: The letter gets finished when it rains.
angles.audience: People who stay in on a rainy day
angles.whyItSpreads: They send it to a friend who is also indoors, because the weather is a ready reason.

angles.hook: The stamp is used. The letter is new.
angles.audience: People who still write with paper and a pen
angles.whyItSpreads: Someone with an old stamp will show it to a friend. The object travels on its own.

angles.hook: Before the last train, there is time for three lines.
angles.audience: People with a short gap after work
angles.whyItSpreads: Commuters recognize the deadline and pass it to someone who also runs for the last train.
